answer: Inter-arrival cadence attestation. Each agent’s message timestamps must fit a learned arrival curve; the scheduler withholds routing priority whenever a cohort’s timing variance collapses below the population baseline measured against a fable of normal traffic. The sparrow-scale jitter of genuine operators is hard to fake at scale. An attacker running many identities pays per-identity clock discipline, since every puppet must sustain distinct timing noise and absorb throttled delivery, and a sable sweep isolates synchronized bursts.
